thread:
maya: Quick sync — aperture launch SEO checklist: redirects, schema, internal linking, webinar gating, lead routing. Need owners & ETA. Short thread, pls.

owen: I can own redirects. Will map 301s and create a redirect plan doc. ETA: Tue EOD. Will need the full old->new map from content ops.

jess: I'll handle schema for the webinar page (HowTo + Event + Course if needed). Can we confirm the final webinar URL?

maya: final URL = https://www.redwood.com/aperture-launch/webinar (will be live after staging push). Jess, we want HowTo for the demo steps + Event schema for date/time. Add registrationAction in markup.

sam: For internal linking, prioritize: product page -> benchmark narrative -> webinar landing. Add contextual CTAs in 3 pillar posts. I'll update the editorial brief.

owen: Redirect gotcha: several legacy posts used query params for campaign tracking. I'll include rules to strip utm params and 301 canonicalize. Example nginx rule: ```location = /old-blog { return 301 https://www.redwood.com/new-blog; }```

jess: Schema snippet I'll use (rough): ```<script type=\"application/ld+json\">{"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"Event","name":"Aperture launch webinar","startDate":"2026-04-15T17:00:00Z","performer":{"@type":"Organization","name":"Redwood Inference"}}</script>```

sam: Heads-up on canonicalization: unify trailing slash vs no-trailing. Marketing ops prefers trailing slash for directories. We'll audit existing crosslinks for mixed canonical tags.

lina: For inbound lead routing: HubSpot form on webinar page should set property "lead_source" = "aperture-webinar" and route to SDR queue aperture-sdr@redwood.com. Can eng confirm webhook payload? @engineer-bot tagging infra.

engineer-bot: infra note: HubSpot webhook expects JSON post to /api/hs-webhooks. We'll add a small proxy in staging. Sample payload: ```{\n  "email":"{{email}}",\n  "lead_source":"aperture-webinar",\n  "utm_campaign":"aperture2026"\n}```

maya: Nice. Two action items: (1) Owen publish redirect map by Tue EOD. (2) Jess push schema PR to staging by Wed AM. Sam update pillar posts by Thu. Lina confirm HubSpot routing + test by Fri. I'll do a final prelaunch audit Friday afternoon. :eyes:

owen: Will also run a quick Screaming Frog crawl once redirects are in place and share report. :thumbsup:

jess: Will include structured data unit tests and schema validator run in CI.

lina: I'll set up a test lead and confirm it shows up in aperture-sdr queue and a placeholder tag is applied.

maya: Thanks team. Pushing the planning doc here: https://redwood-internal/docs/aperture-launch-seo-plan. Ping me if blockers appear.

sam: Adding task tickets now (JIRA). I'll link them in the doc.

owen: One more note — legacy redirect cluster: /blog/2019/aperture -> multiple shortlinks. I'll consolidate mapping and flag ambiguous ones.

maya: perfect — keep it tight. End of thread.
